# email-mcp — Full Documentation
> Version 0.4.1 — FastMCP 3.2+ — 86 tests — 32+ MCP tools

## Quick Start
```powershell
.\start.ps1
```
Requires Python 3.12+, uv. Opens web dashboard at http://localhost:10812.

## Supported Email Systems
- **SMTP/IMAP**: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, ProtonMail, Zoho, GMX, Fastmail
- **Transactional APIs**: SendGrid, Mailgun, Resend, Amazon SES
- **Local Testing**: MailHog, Mailpit, MailCatcher, Inbucket
- **Webhooks**: Slack, Discord, Telegram

## MCP Tools (32+)
send_email, check_inbox, fetch_email_detail, search_emails, delete_email, mark_email_read, mark_email_unread, email_status, configure_service, remove_service, list_services, email_help, list_folders, create_folder, delete_folder, rename_folder, mailing_lists_catalog, mailing_list_latest, suggest_email_subject, email_agentic_assist, start_watcher, stop_watcher, watcher_status, add_contact, search_contacts, run_workflow, add_auto_rule, list_auto_rules, delete_auto_rule, list_pending_replies, approve_reply, auto_respond_now

## Architecture
- **Backend**: FastMCP 3.2+ / FastAPI on port 10813
- **Frontend**: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind on port 10812
- **DB**: JSON file-based (contacts, drafts, rules, signatures, templates, scheduled)
- **AI**: Multi-provider (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google)

## Key Features
- AI-assisted compose, improve, expand, and creative workflows (7 presets)
- Auto-respond engine with rule matching, AI drafting, spam detection, spoof mode
- Bulk send with rate limiting and anti-spam safeguards
- Mail Watcher: background IMAP polling with webhook notifications
- Mail Lab: throwaway aiosmtpd SMTP server with AI message generator
- Contact import: CSV, vCard, Google People API, Microsoft Graph API + curated official lists
- Prompt injection defense: Unicode stripping + safety boundary wrapping
- Dual transport: stdio (Claude Desktop) + HTTP streamable

See [README.md](README.md) for full details.
See [docs/](docs/) for setup guides.
